facts.text: The Shawnee County Promise provides a tuition-free education at Washburn University for full-time eligible graduates of Shawnee County high schools who have a household income of $75,000 or less and under $75,000 in assets.

sources.title: Shawnee County Promise - Washburn University
sources.quote: The Shawnee County Promise ensures that full-time eligible students who graduated from a high school or home school in Shawnee County can receive a tuition-free college education from Washburn.

sources.title: Shawnee County Promise - Washburn University
sources.quote: If you are either Pell Grant Eligible OR demonstrate a household income of $75,000 or less AND have less than $75,000 in assets on your FAFSA.
